calls.title: Arts in the County Administration Building Program
calls.organization: Alachua County Board of County Commissioners / Alachua County Arts Council
calls.budget_note: No payment stated; artwork is loaned for display
calls.eligibility: local artists (not defined further); must sign a Public Art Loan and Display Agreement
calls.notes: Rotating loan display of about three months in the county building. Artists handle delivery, install, insurance and removal. Not a commission.

calls.title: Call to "Tile" Artists – Aqua Crest Aquatic Complex
calls.organization: Palm Beach County Art in Public Places
calls.budget_note: Maximum fixed fee $348,000, all-inclusive; shortlisted artists get a $1,000 honorarium
calls.eligibility: adult professional artists with experience in architecturally integrated tile art
calls.notes: Tile artwork wrapping the upper part of the entrance/ticketing building. Applications go through CODAworx.

calls.title: Call to Artists: Monumental Public Art Sculpture
calls.organization: City of Orlando
calls.eligibility: professional artists and artist teams
calls.notes: Asks for preliminary concept proposals for a large contemporary sculpture in a new 14.2-acre park. The city page gives no budget. Utah Division of Arts & Museums lists this call at $130,000, but that figure is not on the city page.

calls.title: Open Call: 2027 Vizcaya Arts Residency + Commission
calls.organization: Vizcaya Museum and Gardens
calls.budget_note: $12,500 artist fee plus a production budget of up to $25,000
calls.eligibility: South Florida-based artists (Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach) at any career stage, any discipline
calls.notes: Residency with a site-responsive commission for the Main House on the theme 'Holding Time', exhibited Nov 2027 to May 2028.

calls.title: Tangelo Park Community Center—RFQ
calls.organization: Orange County Arts & Cultural Affairs / Public Art Review Board
calls.notes: The county page lists the RFQ and the deadline but not the budget or eligibility. A news report gives a $28,200 budget; we did not confirm it on an agency page.

calls.title: Holocaust Art RFQ
calls.organization: The Jewish Federation of Sarasota-Manatee
calls.budget_note: Budgets stated as approximately $100,000 to $200,000; three commissions; design honorariums available
calls.eligibility: professional artists or teams with outdoor public art experience and materials suited to Florida's climate
calls.notes: Three outdoor works for a Holocaust art and history installation: resistance, survivor resilience, and a photography-based piece. The Florida Division of Arts and Culture also lists this call.

calls.title: Public Art Restoration – Conservation
calls.organization: Broward County Cultural Division, Public Art & Design Program
calls.eligibility: professional visual artists, artist-led teams and conservation specialists based in South Florida
calls.notes: Builds a pool of specialists to repair and restore works in the county's public art collection. Not a new commission. ArtsCalendar.com is run by the Broward Cultural Division.

calls.title: Exhibition Program – Gallery for Innovation and the Arts
calls.organization: Florida Department of State, Division of Arts and Culture
calls.budget_note: No fee stated; the Division covers insurance and installation, and the artist covers shipping
calls.eligibility: Florida artists and organizations
calls.notes: A rolling call for exhibitions in a state building, scheduled up to 2–3 years ahead. Borderline: this is an exhibition program, not a commission.

calls.title: Huntington Theatre – East Wing Art Commission – Request for Qualifications
calls.organization: Huntington Theatre Company
calls.budget_note: $25,000 for artist fee and fabrication combined
calls.eligibility: mid-career or established artists with 15+ years of practice and large-scale public work experience; Boston residency not required
calls.notes: Large-scale artwork for public space on the Avenue of the Arts. Murals are excluded and a community jury reviews entries anonymously.

calls.title: Public Art Review Committee Seeks Artists for Hanover Garage Project
calls.organization: City of Portsmouth Public Art Review Committee
calls.budget_note: Maximum $60,000 covering all project expenses
calls.eligibility: any type of artist (no restrictions stated)
calls.notes: A mural is preferred, but sculpture or projection/lighting on the garage also qualifies. The full RFP is on the city's purchasing page.

calls.title: Utah Public Art Program Opportunity – Utah State University Animal Sciences Building
calls.organization: Utah Division of Arts & Museums, Utah Public Art Program
calls.eligibility: artists or artist teams (no further restrictions stated)
calls.notes: State percent-for-art project for interior artwork on learning and collaboration. The page does not name the campus city.

calls.title: City seeks portable artworks for Public Art Collection
calls.organization: City of Bellevue Arts Program
calls.budget_note: Maximum total purchase of $12,000 per artist (up to five pieces)
calls.eligibility: professional visual artists in Island, King, Kitsap, Kittitas, Chelan, Pierce, San Juan, Skagit or Snohomish counties
calls.notes: Buys existing 2D and 3D works for display in city-owned public buildings.

calls.title: Call for Sculptors and Fabricators
calls.organization: City of Las Vegas Public Art Program
calls.budget_note: Pre-qualified roster; future project budgets range from under $10,000 to up to $300,000 per project
calls.eligibility: sculptors and fabricators (no geographic restriction stated)
calls.notes: Roster valid for about three years for upcoming city sculpture projects. The budget is per future project, not a single commission.

calls.title: Request for Qualifications: La Raza Park Public Art Commission
calls.organization: Denver Arts & Venues – Denver Public Art
calls.budget_note: $136,000, all-inclusive (Denver 1% for Public Art)
calls.eligibility: artists or artist teams residing in the United States
calls.notes: Durable exterior sculpture rooted in Northside Denver heritage. First-time public artists are welcome.

calls.title: ASC Call to Artists – Mecklenburg County – Bryant Park
calls.organization: Arts & Science Council for Mecklenburg County
calls.budget_note: $130,492, all-inclusive
calls.eligibility: US-based professional artists/teams who have completed public art commissions in the past 10 years
calls.notes: Interactive work at the park's Lover's Leap area, such as seating, paving, sculpture or wayfinding. Must withstand flood water. Installation is planned for 2029.

calls.title: National Public Art Call for Artists Managed by RISCA
calls.organization: Rhode Island State Council on the Arts (RISCA)
calls.budget_note: $225,000, all-inclusive
calls.eligibility: professional artists nationally; undergraduate students not eligible
calls.notes: The page says 'Oct. 15' with no year. 2026 is inferred from the other current listings on the page.

calls.title: Call to Artist Brandi Fenton Angels Path Sculpture Walk
calls.organization: Angels Path Sculpture Walk
calls.budget_note: $15,000, all-inclusive (design, fabrication, delivery to Tucson)
calls.notes: Permanent, durable sculpture depicting an angel or the essence of one. Listed by the Arizona Commission on the Arts.

calls.title: Welcome Race Fans 2027 Seeks Artists
calls.organization: Indy Arts Council (with Indianapolis Motor Speedway)
calls.budget_note: $3,000 per artist ($2,500 commission + $500 licensing); five artists
calls.eligibility: professional artists 18+ living in or strongly tied to nine central Indiana counties
calls.notes: Original 2D/3D works on the theme 'This is May', shown at public sites around Indianapolis and Speedway in April–June 2027.

calls.title: Request for Qualifications: Functional Public Art Installation
calls.organization: Louisville Downtown Partnership
calls.eligibility: open to all; Kentucky residents get bonus scoring points
calls.notes: A relocatable installation that provides seating, shade or lighting on a downtown lawn.

calls.title: Wilsonville Wrapped – A Utility Box Public Art Program
calls.organization: City of Wilsonville / Arts, Culture, and Heritage Commission
calls.budget_note: $500 stipend per box
calls.eligibility: visual artists of any medium, designers, illustrators, photographers and students aged 16+
calls.notes: Pilot program putting existing artwork on traffic signal boxes as vinyl wraps.

calls.title: Graco Park tunnel art project
calls.organization: City of Minneapolis Arts & Cultural Affairs
calls.eligibility: artists at all skill levels (no residency restriction stated); community-engagement experience expected
calls.notes: An intent-to-apply form is due Oct 16. The page shows no year on the deadline; 2026 is inferred from the page's Sept 18, 2026 update.

calls.title: City seeks artist for public art project at Martin Luther King Jr. Library
calls.organization: City of Sacramento Office of Arts and Culture (Art in Public Places)
calls.budget_note: Total award $151,500 (City 2% for Public Art)
calls.eligibility: professional artists; extra consideration for experience in or ties to south Sacramento
calls.notes: A 3D wall-hung work on civil rights at the library entrance. Painted murals on the brick are not allowed.

calls.title: Call to Artists | Visitor & Conference Center | City of Avondale
calls.organization: City of Avondale
calls.budget_note: $50,000, all-inclusive
calls.eligibility: professional sculpture artists and design architects
calls.notes: Large 3D sculpture with a water element on the theme of agricultural heritage (blooming cotton), to be completed by May 2027.

calls.title: Fairport-Perinton Art Trail – Art Installation
calls.organization: Fairport Public Arts Committee
calls.budget_note: $30,000 total project budget
calls.eligibility: artists and artist teams (no further restrictions on page)
calls.notes: Site-specific work for the canal-side art trail. Funded by the Canal Days Committee.

calls.title: Signature Public Art Commission for the Aplin Center at Texas A&M University
calls.organization: Texas A&M University (University Art Galleries)
calls.budget_note: Not stated; finalists receive a design stipend (amount given on invitation)
calls.eligibility: professional artists/artist-led teams with large-scale public art commission experience
calls.notes: The page says applications are accepted 'through October of 2026'. Oct 31 is inferred because no exact date is given. Monumental work, installation targeted for spring 2028.

calls.title: Public Art Proposals – Site Specific Installations (2027 ArtFields Festival)
calls.organization: ArtFields
calls.eligibility: artists in AL, AR, FL, GA, KY, LA, MS, NC, SC, TN, VA or WV (stated for most festival opportunities)
calls.notes: Large site-specific installations around town for the April 9–May 1, 2027 festival. Florida artists are eligible.

calls.title: Call to Artists | Donatela Park
calls.organization: City of Avondale
calls.budget_note: $100,000, all-inclusive
calls.eligibility: professional sculpture artists and design architects
calls.notes: Sculpture for a new 5.4-acre neighborhood park, to be installed by February 2027. Listed by the Arizona Commission on the Arts.

calls.title: SawMural Mini-Mural Festival Request for Qualifications
calls.organization: City of Albuquerque Public Art Program
calls.budget_note: $4,000 per selected artist; up to 20 artists
calls.eligibility: legal residents of Bernalillo, Sandoval, Torrance or Valencia counties
calls.notes: Mini-mural panels on view May–Aug 2027. Up to three may enter the city collection.

calls.title: Call for Art – Art Crossings #4 and #5
calls.organization: City of Olympia Parks, Arts & Recreation
calls.budget_note: $55,000 per project; two projects awarded to separate artists
calls.eligibility: artists with a connection to Olympia, WA; Olympia-based artists strongly encouraged
calls.notes: Paired gateway markers on civic boulevards. The city handles foundations and installation.

calls.title: Art in Transit Open Call for Artwork
calls.organization: Washington Metropolitan Area Transit Authority (WMATA)
calls.budget_note: Not stated; an artist fee is provided per project
calls.eligibility: residents of DC, Maryland or Virginia aged 18+, priority to Metro's service area
calls.notes: A rolling artist pool for barricade wraps, digital screens and station installations.

calls.title: Art at the Airport Temporary Exhibitions Request for Proposals
calls.organization: Indianapolis Airport Authority and Indy Arts Council
calls.budget_note: Loan fee up to $500 per location; artist covers other costs
calls.eligibility: artists 18+; preference for Indiana and especially central Indiana artists
calls.notes: Four- to six-month installations in terminal cases and gallery space, plus 60-second video slots.
